question_text: Under Article X of the 1987 Constitution, autonomous regions may be created in Muslim Mindanao and the Cordilleras. Which of the following is a requirement for the creation of an autonomous region?

options.text: A majority vote of the residents in the affected areas in a plebiscite.
A law passed by Congress with a two-thirds vote of all its members.
A resolution from the local government units requesting autonomy.
A proclamation by the President declaring the region autonomous.
